traceCompleteness.rule: windows by request start on the fault receipt's monotonic clock. Fault cells: pre-onset = start before the onset command was issued; fault-and-drain = start in [onset command issued, route ready + drainSeconds]; after-drain = later. No-fault cells: one whole-measurement window. (i) incomplete traces of fault-and-drain requests are counted and recorded (with request tokens) as the fault's effect, never blocking; (ii) the cell is blocked only if the successful requests of the other windows with an incomplete trace number more than max(allowanceMinimum, floor(allowanceShare x their successful requests)). Complete = the request's own trace id observed and exactly the route's services. Every incomplete trace is counted per window (successful and unsuccessful separately) in trace-completeness.json, evaluated on the target before the next cell and replayed by the terminal

containerHealthGuard.rule: every project container is inspected right before the warm-up (baseline) and after the cell's captures, before cleanup (final): State.OOMKilled, RestartCount, status and HostConfig.Memory are recorded in container-health.json; the cell is invalid if any container has OOMKilled true, if an application container restarted or was replaced between baseline and final, or if a declared memory limit is not in effect; replayed by the terminal
